epitaphs.epitaph: Lethal cellular degradation. Biological remains require deep burial. Below the official line, smaller, cut with a nail: they were not contagious at the end. We held their hand anyway.
Terminated by hostiles. Equipment recovered and sanitized. Scratched sideways underneath: they did not run. Nobody ran. That is the whole story.
Caloric deficit reached terminal state. Carved underneath in a different hand: gave their share away three times. The third time is logged here.
Cardiovascular collapse due to sustained labor output. Carved deep underneath: rested on the seventh day, finally. We finished their shift for them.
Pathological contamination event. Sector quarantined. Underneath, in smaller letters: we talked through the door every night. The door logged nothing. We did.
Asset failed to return from surface operations. Logged as loss. Carved under it with a knife point: not an asset. A friend. The log is wrong, and we are leaving it that way.
Severe structural damage to biological unit. Underneath, almost too rough to read: carried in. Not left alone. That much is ours to say.
Termination logged. Rations redistributed. Underneath, the newest carving on the stone: still owe them a name. Working on it.
The dosimeter film on her lapel turned jet black before the relief shift arrived.
He said the air tasted of copper two hours before the fever took his legs.
Three people made it through the culvert gate because she stayed behind to draw the fire.
He dropped behind the fuel tank and never had the chance to unshoulder his rifle.
Her name was still on the distribution clipboard when the last sack of meal spoiled.
He weighed less than thirty kilos when they carried him up from the boiler trench.
She laid her wrench on the pump casing and leaned her forehead against the cool pipe.
His name was crossed off the ward roster before the second dose of penicillin arrived.
They found his pack three miles past the radio mast with the compass dial smashed inward.
The winch cable snapped during the generator hoist and left no time for anyone to yell.
The wind tore her tarp away while she was searching for the road marker in the dark.
Found kneeling inside the hollowed boiler with his damp wool coat stiffened by the rime.
We carved her name where she used to sit because no one found words for the rest.
An empty bunk in Section Four that nobody in the squad has the heart to reassign.
We boiled the needle three times, but the red line crept past his elbow anyway.
He remembered what grass looked like under clear sunlight and told the children until his voice failed.
Eighty-two winters counted on the beam, which is sixty more than anyone had reason to expect.
The pontoon rope snapped in the spring current before anyone on the bank could throw another.
Blackened boots left beside the fire shovel because the numbness had already reached his knees.
Drank from the condensate drip behind the transformer vault before the test strip turned bright purple.
They brought him out to the gravel pit at sunrise and read no charges from the ledger.
No tags, no journal, and only three brass buttons left in the gravel beneath the cairn.
